snippet.title: Acts of Blood - XBOX Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
JUST ANNOUNCED: Acts of Blood is coming soon to XBOX Series X|S! 

Hendra will have his revenge! Brawl through the Indonesian underground in Acts of Blood, a hand-to-hand battler brimming with unforgiving enemies, brutal combos, and a whole lotta blood.
